story.title: My First Online Class
paragraphs_en: Today is Monday. It is Anie’s first online class today. ‘Wake Up Anie. You have your class.’ Mother said waking her up. Today is Monday. It is Anie’s first online class today. ‘Wake Up Anie. You have your class.’ Mother said waking her up. ‘Five minutes Mamma.’ Anie took another nap.
She got up suddenly. She washed and dressed and was ready in 30 minutes. ‘It’s my online class’.
My online class. On Papa’s laptop! How will it be? Like Mamma and I talk to friends?

Papa says it is because all schools are closed and there is a virus. It is safe at home. Anie kept thinking. Papa says it is because all schools are closed and there is a virus. It is safe at home. Anie kept thinking.

‘Oh! No school dress. I will have my class here on my bed.’ Like Papa and Mamma work now. After Anie had her lunch, she was ready for class. After Anie had her lunch, she was ready for class. Oh! No school dress. I will have my class here on my bed. Like Papa and Mamma work now.

Laptop was opened. Mamma opened something which she had not seen before. This was different than other video calls. Laptop was opened. Mamma opened something which she had not seen before. This was different than other video calls.
Soon she could see her friends and teacher. They were in different boxes on the screen. Anie’s eyes grew bigger. ‘I can see all of them together.’

Annie was happy and excited about many things. She was seeing all her friends and teacher together. She was at home on her bed. She was using Papa’s laptop which made her feel older. She was seeing all her friends and teacher together. She was at home on her bed. She was using Papa’s laptop which made her feel older. Annie was happy and excited about many things.

The class started with safety measures all should take to get away from virus. Teacher said it is very important to know. She repeated after her teacher. ‘Wash your hands with soap often.’ ‘Stay Home’ ‘ Keep safe distance’ ‘Wear mask’ The class started with safety measures all should take to protect from the virus. The teacher said it is very important to know. She repeated after her teacher. ‘Wash your hands with soap often.’ ‘Wear mask’ ‘ Keep safe distance’ ‘Stay Home’

And the class went on for 30 minutes. She is happy to come out of her online classroom and meet everyone in the house. She plays a little, meets her Grandpa and Grandma, bunny and her little brother who is still sleeping. And the class went on for 30 minutes. She is happy to come out of her online classroom and meet everyone in the house. She plays a little with bunny and her little brother who is still asleep. Now, Anie is ready for her next online class. She loves to meet her friends and teacher. She likes to talk to them and see them.

Her brother also likes to see them. Sometimes he is so happy that he joins the class by jumping in front of the screen and makes everybody laugh. Her brother also likes to see them. Sometimes he is so happy that he joins the class by jumping in front of the screen and makes everyone laugh.

Mamma is happy to see her safe and also studying. So is Papa and everybody else in the family. Except bunny, who is always ready to play. Mamma is happy to see her safe and also studying. So is Papa and everybody else in the family. Except for bunny, who is always ready to play. Anie wishes to see her friends and teacher in the school. B ut she is happy that she can see them and talk to them - through her online class.
